articles.summary: Green Brick Partners, Inc. (NYSE: GRBK) (the “Company” or “Green Brick”), the third largest homebuilder in Dallas-Fort Worth, announced that it will release its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, after the market closes on October 28, 2026. Jim Brickman, Green Brick’s CEO, will host an earnings conference call to discuss its results at 12:00 p.m. Eastern Time on Thursday, October 29, 2026. The call will be webcast on the Company’s website Investors.greenbrickpartners.com. To participate in the live telephone conference call: North America toll-free dial-in number: 1-833-461-5787 International dial-in number: 1-585-542-9983 Meeting ID: 508067954 To access a telephone replay of the call: North America toll-free dial-in number: 1-833-309-1852 International dial-in number: 1-833-309-1852 Access code: 508067954 Date Accessible Through: November 29, 2026 About Green Brick Partners, Inc.
